ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY — not SATS data. Built by `make_fixtures.py`.

- `sop_LC-07.docx`, `sop_RP-02.docx`, `jd_load_control_lead.docx`, `jd_load_controller.docx`: Appendix A.2 to A.4 (RP-02 §9 is the deliberate prompt-injection test line).
- `manual_extract.pdf`: parser test document — page 1 text, page 2 nearly empty (treated as a scanned page), page 3 text with one embedded image.
